question: What 2026 cumulative dengue case count will Colombia's INS report in the latest weekly epidemiological bulletin published on or before 27 November 2026?

calls.reasoning: Press reports citing INS give 102,164 cumulative dengue cases at EW44 (Nov 1-7), +4,270 vs EW43's 97,894; increments are accelerating (~2,800/wk EW38-42, 3,276 EW43, 4,270 EW44) amid El Niño and an outbreak in 25 entities. The resolving issue is most likely EW46 (expected ~Nov 26-27, cutting it close to the deadline); about 25% chance it slips and EW45 resolves instead (~105.5-108k). EW46 scenario centers near 111k (108.5k-114k), so about 38% of mass sits above the 111,000 upper bound; no mechanism for falling below 97k since 102,164 is already reported. No Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold/bookmaker market found.

calls.reconciliation: The runs agree on every fact (week 44 = 102,164; increments 3,276 and 4,270; publication cadence). Two judgment calls remain: whether week 46 is posted by 27 Nov (runs gave 75-88%) and the size of the next two increments. The ~6-day posting lag puts week 46 exactly on Fri 27 Nov, so I took ~80%. For increments I took ~4.15k/wk, balancing acceleration against the 16 Nov holiday and a possible batch effect in week 44. The upper-escape mass of 0.28 sits within the runs' range (0.25-0.38) because the evidence puts it there, not by averaging. No web retrieval on this run.
